tests.name: claude CLI adapter: tool-free non-interactive flags, prompt on stdin only, isolated cwd, vault env scrubbed
codex CLI adapter: read-only sandbox, ephemeral, last-message file, prompt on stdin
agent CLI failures are sanitized, bounded and cancellable
backend selection: auto prefers claude then codex; env and config swap it; missing CLIs are reported, never executed by doctor
jobs run through the agent CLI; private workspace content is blocked unless the owner opts in
swapping the backend in mdb.yaml or by environment changes which agent serves `mdb intelligence run`, including an OpenAI-compatible API
default configuration uses a local agent CLI when one exists, and is deterministic-only when none does
OpenAI-compatible API: path, headers, body, content-part arrays and response_format fallback all behave
manual session capture redacts secrets, revisions close once, automatic capture is opt-in
source synthesis is review-gated, evidence checked, durable and deduplicated
malformed provider output enters dead letter without canonical writes
dream fixture composes multiple domains as hypothesis, private scope never reaches global context
actor isolation, unauthorized evidence and cross-scope sharing are rejected before proposal persistence
revoking an actor grant withdraws queued proposal metadata and blocks review
explicit compiler inputs reach model exclusively and inaccessible object IDs fail before execution
adapter sends bounded chat request with auth, delimits untrusted documents, and strictly parses the proposal
transient 5xx and 429 are retried with bounded attempts; success is returned
authentication failures are not retried and errors never disclose bodies, prompts or keys
timeouts and caller cancellation abort the request without hanging or retrying cancellation
malformed, over-wide, truncated and non-JSON model output is rejected with INVALID_MODEL_OUTPUT
input over the token budget fails before any network request
critic verdicts are parsed strictly and can only accept or reject
configuration: ollama is local and keyless, remote needs network consent and a key from the environment
profile: explicit preference outranks conflicting inference, newer explicit statement supersedes older inference, history is preserved
profile: sensitive inferred items need explicit confirmation, rejection stores nothing, model-declared sensitivity is honored
session end queues a retrospective over exactly that session; approval links evidence and originals stay untouched
session end without a provider queues work that is blocked, never a fabricated summary
critic: duplicate and over-certain dreams are rejected with preserved rationale; no second discovery is stored
critic: a model critic can reject or flag but never approve; critic outages do not block deterministic review
privacy: remote providers never receive private workspace content unless the vault explicitly allows it
budgets, strict schema, sanitized errors, retries and cancellation at the job level
configured Ollama-style endpoint drives a wiki job end to end; output is staged, validated and never written directly
real model: wiki synthesis and critic return schema-valid, evidence-bound, review-gated output
real model evaluation: labeled preference extraction and micro/deep/strategic cross-domain hypotheses
registry exposes all 22 KB adapters and 12 MDB skills without legacy dispatch
upstream assets retain exact imported bytes
skills pass explicit scope to versioned APIs and refuse self-assigned identity
history imports need consent and configured capture source, never scan directories
semantic skills queue proposals and promotion requires explicit sanitized review
export and critique expose authorized documents only and source instructions have no authority
real actor-bound adapters preserve source bytes, revision history and workspace isolation

gaps.item: Real-model evaluation pack (20+ documents, 4+ domains, scored)
gaps.reason: Only a structural opt-in integration test exists (run once against local gpt-oss, see verification/phase-8.md). No evaluation pack, precision or groundedness metrics.

gaps.item: Wiki ingest→classify→extract→link→lint pipeline and incremental affected-page detection

gaps.reason: Session-end retrospective is implemented; no task-complete trigger or handoff document.

gaps.item: Distinct dream modes (micro/deep/strategic) with different candidate retrieval
gaps.reason: The mode is accepted as a flag but candidate selection and ranking are identical.

gaps.item: Dream validation loop and recursion budget tests
gaps.reason: No validation-outcome feedback and no test that dreams cannot breed on unvalidated dreams.

gaps.item: Worker: lease expiry with concurrent workers, index-job priority, replay of dead letters
gaps.reason: Jobs, retries, dead letters and idempotency are tested sequentially; concurrent-worker and priority behaviour are not.

gaps.item: Job idempotency key bound to source revision + pipeline version
gaps.reason: Jobs deduplicate by input digest, proposals by content fingerprint; pipeline version is not part of the key.

limitations: The critic is deterministic (lexical duplicate, certainty, preference conflict, sensitivity keywords) plus an optional model critic that can only reject or flag.
Sensitive-content detection is a keyword heuristic.
